desc.en: Oil extracted from fats in plants. While it's mostly from Palma tree seeds, it contains various other plant oils. It has many uses, from home cooking to factories.
desc.ja: 植物に含まれる脂肪を抽出した油。パルマの木の種子を中心に色々な植物の油がある。家庭料理から工場まで、さまざまな所で使われている

desc.en: Effect: Increases sell price at shops by a small amount.
desc.ja: 効果：お店の買取価格が少し上がる

desc.en: Effect: Increases the effect of attack items by 5％.
desc.ja: 効果：攻撃アイテムの効果が５％上昇する

desc.en: Effect: Enhances healing items by a fixed amount. Weaker power results in stronger enhancement.
desc.ja: 効果：回復アイテムが固定値で少し強化される。元の威力が弱いほど効果は高い
